companies.name: セイバー・ヘルスケア

relations.text: 64施設を保有・賃貸する合弁を設立
relations.text_en: Formed a JV to own and lease 64 facilities

source.label: Omega Healthcare 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In October 2025, the Company formed a JV with affiliates of Saber Healthcare Holdings, LLC ("Saber") to own and lease 64 facilities that were previously wholly owned by affiliates of Saber.

relations.text: 34施設を担保に約4.8億ドルを融資
relations.text_en: About $480 million of mortgage loans secured by 34 facilities

source.label: Omega Healthcare 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, Omega had $ 480.0 million and $ 525.5 million, respectively, of mortgage notes with Ciena secured by 34 and 38 facilities, respectively.
